rationale: The VWAP anchored at the 03:00 London open is the average price of everyone who traded the European morning, so when price crosses it and holds on the new side for a few 5-minute closes the average trader on the old side is losing and exits, which pushes price further (a screen held to 15:58, the real London rule is flat by 09:25). Losing side: European-morning traders positioned on the old side of the London VWAP, and those who fade the reclaim.
notes: C / R#12: tf close crosses session VWAP and the next `hold` closes stay on the new side -> enter with it.
